measure: dollars of self/family-paid medical spending per person with positive out-of-pocket spending (weighted)
notes: 2015-2016 read from SAS transport (XPORT) files; 2017-2024 from Stata files because the 2017+ SAS transport files are CPORT format. Persons with zero person weight are excluded (out of scope for the year). pandas reads an exact zero in the 2015-2016 transport files as 5.4e-79; those were reset to 0 (13,409 and 13,238 records). Share with positive spending is 71-74% every year (72.4% in 2024, matching the codebook figure in REPORT.md). Possible break in 2018: the first year collected entirely with MEPS's redesigned interview; the per-person value jumps 20% from 2017 to 2018 against 4-5% a year otherwise, and AHRQ's HC-207/HC-209 documentation warns about trend analysis across the transition. A published out-of-pocket dollar total to check against was not found quickly (Statistical Brief 507 gives only a share: about one in eight 2015 health dollars paid out of pocket).
